howItWorks.heading: How does the Rahnamo platform work?
howItWorks.subheading: How to get a 1-on-1 consultation from Central Asia's top experts
howItWorks.step1Title: Choose a Rahnamo and a time
howItWorks.step1Body: Pick the specialist that fits you from the catalog, choose the Standard or Premium package, and book a time that works.
howItWorks.step2Title: Pay and fill in your details
howItWorks.step2Body: Make a secure payment via Payme, Click, or Uzum Bank. Write the main question you'd like to ask your Rahnamo.
howItWorks.step3Body: Your ticket and video meeting link are sent immediately to your email and Telegram. Start the conversation at the scheduled time.

items.q: What happens if a consultation is cancelled or rescheduled?
items.a: If you contact our administrator at least 12 hours before the session starts, you'll receive a 100% refund, or your session will be moved to another time that works for you.

items.q: What platform is the session held on?
items.a: All 1-on-1 consultations are held over a video link (no registration required). The room link is sent to you by email and Telegram.

items.q: How can I join the list of Rahnamo?
items.a: If you're also an experienced professional in your field, you can fill out the application by clicking "Become a Rahnamo" in the menu. Your profile will be reviewed within 24 hours.
